items.title: Meta removes ad-set-level placement exclusion controls
items.why: Workflow break, not cosmetic: campaigns relying on placement exclusions to keep spend off weak surfaces need checking now.

items.title: Google Ads extends Limited Ad Serving policy to all accounts
items.why: Reduced impressions can hit accounts with no obvious policy strike — worth knowing before a client loses reach unexpectedly.

items.title: Google Ads adds Customer Lifecycle Optimization to conversion goals
items.why: Lets accounts optimise toward lifecycle stages instead of one-off conversions — relevant for any client running a retention or LTV play.

items.title: Google Ads starts auto-labeling customer lists by type
items.why: Passive change that can shift how remarketing lists get treated — worth a spot check on client accounts.

items.title: Gemini Omni lands in Google Ads Asset Studio
items.why: Generates on-brand creative variants directly inside Asset Studio — could cut creative production time on Performance Max accounts.

items.title: Uniphore launches Marketing AI, a CDP alternative
items.why: Positioned to replace a traditional customer data platform — early-stage, but worth a watch if a client conversation touches CDP consolidation.

items.title: Ad watchdog finds Pistachio Papi breached obscenity and violence rules with AI-generated clip
items.why: A brand's AI-generated ad copped two Ad Standards breaches in a month — a live reminder to run AI creative through the same compliance checks as anything else.

items.title: Q&A: Frank Body's Jessica Hatzis on what founders get wrong and right about building cult brands
items.why: The Frank Body and Willow & Blake co-founder on the instincts behind building $1B+ in Australian brand value — a useful read before the next client brand strategy pitch.

items.title: From the cost of living to nostalgia: Why Ooshies became such a hit in 2026
items.why: A campaign strategist breaks down why Woolworths' Ooshies giveaway sold out nationally — a case study angle worth borrowing for retail clients.

items.title: R&D Tax Incentive (R&DTI)
items.why: Ongoing federal tax offset for eligible R&D activity — relevant if the agency or a client is building custom tooling, AI features, or proprietary tech. Rules stay as-is until 1 July 2028.

items.title: Small Business Energy Incentive
items.why: Bonus tax deduction of up to $20,000 for eligible energy-efficient assets and improvements — a straightforward one for the studio or any SME client's office fit-out.

items.title: Export Market Development Grants (EMDG)
items.why: Matched funding for marketing and promotional activity that helps Australian SMEs grow into export markets — currently closed, but worth flagging to clients eyeing international growth for the next round.

items.title: Boosting Female Founders Initiative — Round 3
items.why: Co-contribution grants of $100,000-$480,000 for majority female-owned and led startups scaling into new markets — Stage 1 EOI has closed, but worth watching for any client that's a female-founded startup.
